metadata.execution: In-process fastapi.testclient.TestClient(src.api.main.app) with the application lifespan; saved producers loaded from local artifacts at startup.

previous_capture.status: Preserved unchanged and superseded: h7-only capture whose AS-01 to AS-06 values were written as constants rather than derived from checks.

scope: Technical request-time consumer verification under #203 only.
Not formal forecast-producer approval; that remains pending under #179.
Not independently reviewed source verification; that remains pending under #179.
Synthetic demonstration inputs; no accuracy, research or inventory-use claim.

AS-01.title: Identity echoed unchanged; unknown SKU/warehouse rejected explicitly

AS-03.title: Inclusive window: target_end_date = origin + h, exactly h days

AS-04.title: Horizon and forecast_type preserved; cumulative and 28-day limitation wording; unsupported horizon rejected

AS-05.title: Designated producer, saved model/preprocessor and input provenance

AS-06.title: Exact response allowlist; no retrospective or inventory fields; such request fields rejected

RT-CONTRACT.title: Health ready; HTTP 200, available, finite quantity; files intact

RT-CHANGED-HISTORY.title: Final-day Units_Sold +5 yields a new input_sha256 with the same producer

RT-REJECTIONS.title: HTTP 422 rejection boundaries without a substitute quantity

observations.note: Informational only. Tree models can return the same quantity for different inputs, so an unchanged quantity is not a failure; the pass/fail signal is the changed input_sha256 against the identical-request control.
